subject: 請問安裝套件遇到錯誤

messages.author: 5169cfb819015f5a
messages.subject: 請問安裝套件遇到錯誤
parts:
請問安裝套件遇到錯誤，錯誤訊息如下：

Warning: Failed to load RGtk2 dynamic library, attempting to install it.
Please install GTK+ from http://ftp.gnome.org/pub/gnome/binaries/win64/gtk+/2.22/gtk+-bundle_2.22.1-20101229_win64.zip
If the package still does not load, please ensure that GTK+ is installed and that it is on your PATH environment variable
IN ANY CASE, RESTART R BEFORE TRYING TO LOAD THE PACKAGE AGAIN
Error in inDL(x, as.logical(local), as.logical(now), ...) : 
  無法載入共享物件 'D:/R_language/library/RGtk2/libs/x64/RGtk2.dll' ：
 LoadLibrary failure:  %1 不是正確的 Win32 應用程式 。

請教如何解決？非常謝謝！
